Scott Killer.notes: While Endo army is up, use Endo-01 to buff your party with both Song abilities, once curse status runs out you're more succeptible to being one-shot. Only swap to party two if your Funtime Foxy passed or you really need Giftboxes now. RWQ is only on Team two only as a safety precaution, can easily be put on Team 1 instead.

Scott Killer (Heavy Grind).caption: LVL. 30 Minimum
Scott Killer (Heavy Grind).notes: This team is much more consistant at beating Scott, and is recommended for Nuzlocke runs. Same tips as normal Scott team minus the fact that you will most likely be able to tank much more hits. Use Happy Jam 2, a lot. Also start using Speed Song as you dont use Endless: Speed in this comp

Rainbow Killer.notes: GAMBLINGGGGG, on harder difficulties, we find it easier to hope and pray with slasher spam. Only swap to team two if a member on team one dies.

Rainbow Killer (Heavy Grind).caption: LVL. 125 Minimum
Rainbow Killer (Heavy Grind).notes: This team is much more consistant for grinding Chica's Magic Rainbow, or if you're on a Nuzlocke and need to win first try. This team abuses the fact Balloons 2 scales exponentially from levels, making it the best attack in the game if you're willing to put in the time.

Chippers Revenge (No Halloween).caption: With only Update 1 Characters
Chippers Revenge (No Halloween).notes: You may be surprised to see that this is the exact same as the Scott, thats because without Halloween Characters This is the best team possible! same tips as the ones against Scott.

Chippers Revenge (Halloween).caption: With Halloween Characters
Chippers Revenge (Halloween).notes: With Halloween Characters it should be much easier. it is reccommended to always keep Gift Boxes up and ALWAYS keep Mega Virus up. Only Swap to Team 2 if your two Gift Boxers die on Team 1.

Chippers Revenge (Heavy Grind).caption: With Halloween Characters + High Level. Minimum LVL. 50
Chippers Revenge (Heavy Grind).notes: Made for Higher level. Due to Chipper doing up to 1000 damage even with defense per hit we decided it was best to forgoe the defensive stuff for more dps. In a Nuzlocke it is recommended to replace Auto: Giftboxes with Endless: Speed.
